root_cause: Rate formatting compared str(60.0) to a CSV display string formatted with two decimals (60.00); recomputed and visual chart values were actually equal.
The visual receipt identifies pages by name and sha256, not page/page_number; checker used the wrong key.
Word receipt stores pdf_pages as a string, while the checker compared it to integers without conversion.
resolution: Corrected exact decimal formatting, matched page-09 by name, and normalized native Word page count to integer; reran deterministic comparison.
